entities.name: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Persian polymath (c. 980–1037) regarded as the father of early modern medicine. His Canon of Medicine was the standard medical textbook in Europe and the Islamic world for 600 years. Also a major philosopher who preserved and extended Aristotelian thought.
